Figure 1:Recursive Agent Optimization with rubric-based trajectory
scoring. A shared-policy root agent delegates subtasks recursively; each completed SubAgent trajectory can receive a Rubric Reward together with the Program or LLM Judge reward.

Figure 2:Recursive execution and trajectory scoring with a shared policy.
Parents delegate subtasks to child agents and commit rubrics before child execution.
The scoring sources shown have different roles across methods: external outcomes directly reward execution in RAO, whereas policy-generated rubric scores reward subtask execution in SERA.
SERA uses external subtask labels to train rubric generation through a separate ranking objective.
